title: 'NHIS: Adults Walking and Climbing Stairs'
author: "Tony Beal"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---
\
```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(patchwork)
path <- getwd()
setwd(path)
source("utils.R")
load("adult_nhis_data.RData")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
walk_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(LAWALKCLIMDIF != 0) |>
  select(LAWALKCLIMDIF)

p_walk_climb <- ggplot(walk_df, aes(factor(LAWALKCLIMDIF, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#B9DEA9", color = "#4B5945", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to LAWALKCLIMDIF", 
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No difficulty", 
      "2" = "Some difficulty", 
      "3" = "A lot of difficulty", 
      "4" = "Cannot do at all",
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 30000)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to LAWALKCLIMDIF", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "LAWALKCLIMDIF Amount of difficulty walking or climbing steps"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12.5, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}
steps_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(WALKDIF12ST1 != 0) |> 
  select(WALKDIF12ST1) 


p_12_steps <- ggplot(steps_df, aes(factor(WALKDIF12ST1, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#DBEB9D", color = "#666E4B", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to WALKDIF12ST1", 
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No difficulty", 
      "2" = "Some difficulty", 
      "3" = "A lot of difficulty", 
      "4" = "Cannot do at all",
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 30000)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to WALKDIF12ST1", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "WALKDIF12ST1 Amount of difficulty walking up or down 12 steps"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )

p_walk_climb + p_12_steps
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
arth_walk_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(ARTHGLUPEV == 2 & LAWALKCLIMDIF != 0) |> 
  select(LAWALKCLIMDIF)

p_arth_walk <- ggplot(arth_walk_df, aes(factor(LAWALKCLIMDIF, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#E3D788", color = "#8A7A53", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Responses to LAWALKCKIMBDIF", 
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No difficulty", 
      "2" = "Some difficulty", 
      "3" = "A lot of difficulty", 
      "4" = "Cannot do at all",
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5000)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to LAWALKCKIMBDIF", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "LAWALKCKIMBDIF Responses of Adults Who Responsed 'Yes'\n to ARTHGLUPEV"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
adult_arth_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$ARTHGLUPEV, 2)
arth_walk_alot1 <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(LAWALKCLIMDIF == 3, ARTHGLUPEV == 2) |> 
  summarise(count = n())
 
arth_walk_alot2 <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(WALKDIF12ST1 == 3, ARTHGLUPEV == 2) |> 
  summarise(count = n())
#   
# `r arth_walk_alot1`, (`r round((arth_walk_alot1/adult_arth_yes)*100, 2)`%) people who answered 'yes' to ARTHGLUPEV also selected 'a lot of difficulty' when asked about difficulty walking or climbing steps.\
# 
# `r arth_walk_alot2`, (`r round((arth_walk_alot2/adult_arth_yes)*100, 2)`%) people who answered 'yes' to ARTHGLUPEV also selected 'a lot of difficulty' when asked about difficulty walking up or down 12 steps.\
```
\
(ARTHGLUPEV: *"Have you EVER been told by a doctor or other health professional that you had some form of arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, lupus, or fibromyalgia (fy-bro-my-AL-jeeuh)?"*)\
